theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds Need Lump Sum Investment Only
body: False. Systematic investments through SIPs let you start with modest amounts, build discipline, and reduce timing risk effectively.
caption: Many believe mutual funds require large upfront investments. In reality, flexible investment options make wealth creation accessible to everyone. Start small, invest regularly, and let compound growth work for you. #MutualFundMyths #SmartInvesting #WealthBuilding #InvestmentTips #FinancialLiteracy
